title: Grab and Move resizes on all edges of a window which are undesirable

judgment.rationale: The report says Alt+right-drag at the bottom-right of a maximized window does not produce the desired size/location in one operation, but its expected behavior repeats the actual bottom/right-edge description. Without intended anchor and edge motion, it is unclear whether this is a defect or a request for combined move-and-resize semantics.
evidence: Issue uses 0.99.1 and Grab and Move resize gesture.
Repro starts at bottom-right of a maximized window and drags toward top-left.
Expected and actual descriptions do not clearly specify which edges stay anchored.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask the author to specify desired edge/anchor geometry before proposing a resize algorithm change.

fix_assessment.rationale: Desired geometry is ambiguous; changing resize anchoring without it could make existing corner-handle behavior worse.

issue_context.summary: The author wants a one-drag size/location adjustment using Grab and Move.
known_information: Report describes Alt+right-click resizing from lower-right corner.
Expected and actual descriptions are nearly identical and do not state a fixed edge.
Pinned Grab and Move resolves a resize handle based on interaction target.
inferences: Desired behavior may combine resizing and translating the window, not simply change resize-only behavior.
issue_context.analysis: Clarify expected final rectangle rather than collect generic diagnostics.
initial_investigation: Read report and pinned Grab and Move resize-target implementation; source has explicit resize handles and target geometry, but requested anchor is unstated.

information_gaps.information: The exact drag start point and intended anchor: should the opposite corner remain fixed, or should the whole window also move while its size changes?
information_gaps.why_needed: The expected/actual wording repeats the same bottom/right behavior and says one drag should be enough, but does not identify desired anchor geometry. Current Grab and Move chooses a resize handle from the start region.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Repeat from a maximized window at one corner; describe which edges should move, which should stay fixed, and the final desired size/location.

comment.body: Thanks for the example. The report’s expected and actual descriptions both mention the bottom/right edges, so could you clarify the desired final geometry? In particular, when dragging from the bottom-right toward the top-left, should the top-left corner stay fixed, the bottom-right stay fixed, or should the window move as well as resize? A simple description of which edges move will tell us whether a resize behavior change is needed.
